description: Per-service launch table for tests/run-go-service-baseline.py. A service named in --rust-services runs its cadence-<service> binary; every other service stays on the original Go server. rustSupported is true only when a gate probe can drive that Rust service end to end; the crates for the other services are not_migrated stubs today.

frontend.note: cadence-frontend is a not_migrated stub; no Rust Frontend gate probe exists

history.note: cadence-history is a not_migrated stub; no Rust History gate probe exists

matching.note: production Ringpop lane driven by tests/matching-service-compat.cjs

worker.note: cadence-worker is a not_migrated stub; no Rust Worker gate probe exists
